question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fastidious
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Fastidious' refers to very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. The English meaning of fastidious is excessively particular, critical, or demanding; hard to please (सूक्ष्मदर्शी).

 
 
• **Example:** He is fastidious in maintaining his professional image at work.
 
 
 
• 'Careful', which is the correct answer, is giving serious attention to detail. Its English meaning is taking pain in one's work; exact; thorough (सावधान).
 
 
• **Example:** He's a careful worker, always double-checking everything.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Hardworking' is tending to work with energy and commitment; diligent (मेहनती).
 
• 'Careless' means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors (लापरवाह).
 
• 'Fast' usually refers to moving or capable of moving at high speed (तेज़).
